generic.Defined scope/population: All active RCSA controls and their cited taxonomy node IDs in Archer GRC
generic.In-scope period: Current taxonomy version cycle through the next annual review date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every RCSA control record cites a valid, active taxonomy node ID
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of mapped controls matches the RCSA control library total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciled crosswalk table saved in Confluence with review date and reviewer
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controls mapped to retired/merged nodes logged with remediation owner
generic.Test population: Full RCSA control library cross-referenced against the taxonomy tree
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if zero controls cite an inactive or orphaned taxonomy node
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged controls routed to the control owner for remapping before close
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mappings judged aligned when every control cites a live taxonomy node
generic.Evidence location: Taxonomy-to-control crosswalk table in Confluence and taxonomy change log

steps.title: Open the RCSA control library and taxonomy tree in Archer GRC
sop: Log into Archer GRC and open the RCSA control library module.
Open the enterprise risk taxonomy tree in a second panel for side-by-side review.
Confirm both views are showing the current published version.
Done when the control library and taxonomy tree are open side by side.
verify: Check the version stamp on each view matches the latest published taxonomy.
Pass when both views load the current version with no stale cache warning.

steps.title: Check each RCSA control cites a valid taxonomy node ID
sop: Step through each control record and read its cited taxonomy node ID.
Compare the ID against the active node list in the taxonomy tree.
Note any control citing a blank, free-text, or unrecognized node ID.
Done when every control record has been checked against the active node list.
verify: Spot-check a sample of ten reviewed controls against the taxonomy tree.
Pass when the sample shows no unrecognized or blank node ID.

steps.title: Flag controls mapped to a retired or merged taxonomy node
sop: Cross-reference each cited node ID against the taxonomy retired/merged node list.
Tag any control citing a retired or merged node as a remediation item.
Record the correct successor node ID as the proposed remap.
Done when every retired/merged citation is tagged with a proposed successor node.
verify: Review the tagged list against the retired-node register for completeness.
Pass when every retired-node citation carries a proposed successor node.

steps.title: Update the taxonomy-to-control crosswalk table in Confluence
sop: Open the taxonomy-to-control crosswalk page in Confluence.
Update each row with the reconciled, current node ID for every control.
Remove rows for controls that have been retired since the last update.
Done when the crosswalk table matches the reconciled control-to-node mapping.
verify: Compare the published crosswalk row count to the RCSA control library count.
Pass when the row counts match with no unmapped control left out.

steps.title: Route flagged controls to the control owner for remapping
sop: Compile the list of controls flagged against retired or merged nodes.
Send the remap request to each control owner with the proposed successor node.
Track owner acknowledgement and completion of the remap in Archer GRC.
Done when every flagged control shows a completed remap or an open owner task.
verify: Check Archer GRC for the remap status field on each flagged control.
Pass when no flagged control remains without an owner response.

steps.title: Record the alignment review in the taxonomy change log
sop: Open the taxonomy change log in Archer GRC.
Enter the alignment review date, reviewer name, and control count reviewed.
Note the count of remaps completed and any still outstanding.
Done when the change log entry is saved with reviewer, date, and counts.
verify: Reopen the change log entry to confirm all fields saved correctly.
Pass when the review date, reviewer, and counts are all present and correct.

steps.title: Sign off the alignment as complete for the cycle
sop: Review the reconciled crosswalk table and the change log entry together.
Confirm zero open remaps remain unresolved past the grace period.
Approve the alignment task as closed in Archer GRC.
Done when the task status is marked closed with sign-off recorded.
verify: Check the task record for the Compliance Manager approval stamp.
Pass when the closure sign-off is present with no open remaps.

generic.Defined scope/population: The prior-year taxonomy version structure, definitions, and node IDs
generic.In-scope period: The taxonomy version superseded at this year's annual review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, effective date range, and node ID list all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived node count matches the prior-year taxonomy's published node count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Version-stamped PDF/CSV export stored with archive date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any export discrepancy logged with correction note before archiving
generic.Test population: The full prior-year taxonomy tree scheduled for retirement
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if the archive is read-only and retention period is applied
generic.Exception handling path: Export errors routed back to the taxonomy owner for re-export
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive accepted when read-only, retention-tagged, and indexed
generic.Evidence location: Taxonomy archive folder in the compliance evidence repository

steps.title: Export the prior-year taxonomy tree from Archer GRC
sop: Open the prior-year taxonomy version in the Archer GRC taxonomy module.
Export the structure, definitions, and node IDs as a version-stamped PDF and CSV pair.
Confirm the export file names include the taxonomy version number.
Done when the PDF/CSV export pair is generated and version-stamped.
verify: Open the exported files and confirm node counts match the source view.
Pass when the export node count equals the source taxonomy node count.

steps.title: Store the export in the taxonomy archive folder
sop: Open the taxonomy archive folder in the compliance evidence repository.
Upload the PDF/CSV export pair tagged with version number and effective date range.
Confirm the folder naming convention matches prior archived versions.
Done when the export is stored under the correctly tagged archive folder.
verify: Browse the archive folder to confirm the new entry appears with correct tags.
Pass when the tagged entry is visible and matches the version number.

steps.title: Apply the records retention period to the archive
sop: Open the records retention schedule for taxonomy documentation.
Apply the specified retention period to the archived version's metadata.
Set the scheduled disposal or review date per the retention schedule.
Done when the retention period and disposal date are recorded on the archive.
verify: Check the archive metadata for the applied retention date field.
Pass when the retention period matches the schedule for taxonomy records.

steps.title: Confirm the archived version is locked read-only
sop: Set the archived file permissions to read-only in the compliance evidence repository.
Attempt a test edit to confirm the lock is enforced.
Remove edit access for all users except the repository administrator.
Done when the archived version cannot be edited in place.
verify: Try opening the file for edit and confirm it opens as view-only.
Pass when no edit access is possible without administrator override.

steps.title: Log the archive location in the version history index
sop: Open the taxonomy version history index in Confluence.
Add a row with the version number, archive location link, and archive date.
Confirm the link resolves to the stored archive folder.
Done when the version history index row is saved with a working link.
verify: Click the logged archive link to confirm it opens the correct file.
Pass when the link opens the correct version-stamped archive.

steps.title: Confirm the archive with the Enterprise Risk Manager
sop: Review the archived export, retention tag, and version history index entry.
Confirm the archive is complete, read-only, and correctly indexed.
Approve the archive as complete for the cycle.
Done when the Enterprise Risk Manager approves the archive as complete.
verify: Check the version history index for the approval note and date.
Pass when the approval note and date are present against the entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: All L1/L2 nodes in the enterprise risk taxonomy tree
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Named risk owner and accountable executive fields populated on every node
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Owner-assignment count matches total L1/L2 node count in Archer GRC
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Owner assignment log with assignment date per node
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vacant-position assignments logged and routed for a named replacement
generic.Test population: Every L1 and L2 taxonomy node in the current tree
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if 100% of nodes show a populated owner field
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned nodes escalated to the Enterprise Risk Manager for resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment complete when every node has an active owner acknowledged
generic.Evidence location: Archer GRC taxonomy owner field and assignment log

steps.title: Open the taxonomy owner field for each node in Archer GRC
sop: Open the taxonomy module in Archer GRC and filter to L1/L2 nodes.
Review the owner and accountable-executive field on each node.
List every node with a blank or vacant-position owner field.
Done when every L1/L2 node has been reviewed for owner status.
verify: Cross-check the list against the taxonomy node count in Archer GRC.
Pass when the reviewed node count equals the total L1/L2 node count.

steps.title: Assign a named owner and executive to each unowned node
sop: Match each unowned node to the business unit responsible for that risk category.
Assign a named risk owner and accountable executive from the current org chart.
Enter both names into the taxonomy owner fields in Archer GRC.
Done when every previously unowned node has a named owner and executive.
verify: Confirm the named owner appears as an active employee in the org chart.
Pass when no assigned owner references a vacant or inactive position.

steps.title: Route owner assignments for acknowledgement
sop: Send the owner assignment notice through the Archer GRC workflow to each named owner.
Set a response deadline for acknowledgement.
Track acknowledgement status on the assignment dashboard.
Done when every assignment notice has been sent through the workflow.
verify: Check the workflow dashboard for delivery confirmation on each notice.
Pass when every notice shows as delivered to the correct owner.

steps.title: Confirm 100% of nodes show a populated owner field
sop: Run the taxonomy completeness report in Archer GRC.
Confirm zero nodes remain with a blank owner or executive field.
Note any residual gap for immediate follow-up.
Done when the completeness report shows zero blank owner fields.
verify: Re-run the report and check the blank-field count field.
Pass when the blank-field count reads zero.

steps.title: Log unacknowledged assignments for escalation
sop: Identify owners who have not acknowledged assignment within the response deadline.
Log each unacknowledged assignment with owner name and days overdue.
Escalate overdue acknowledgements to the owner's manager.
Done when every overdue assignment is logged and escalated.
verify: Review the escalation log for entries against every overdue owner.
Pass when no overdue owner is missing from the escalation log.

steps.title: Close the ownership assignment task
sop: Confirm all nodes carry a populated, acknowledged owner and executive.
Review the completeness report one final time before closing.
Mark the taxonomy ownership task as complete in Archer GRC.
Done when the task is marked complete with no open assignments.
verify: Reopen the task record to confirm the completion status and date.
Pass when the task shows complete with zero open assignments.

generic.Defined scope/population: All identified enterprise risks across the organization
generic.In-scope period: Current taxonomy build cycle before first publication
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every risk assigned to a valid L1 category and L2 sub-category
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Category count in Confluence diagram matches Archer GRC taxonomy module
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hierarchy diagram published with build date in Confluence
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate category candidates logged and resolved before load
generic.Test population: All L1 categories and their L2 sub-categories
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if no risk category duplicates an existing node under a different name
generic.Exception handling path: Duplicate or overlapping categories routed to Enterprise Risk Manager for resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hierarchy accepted when two-level structure has zero duplicate nodes
generic.Evidence location: Taxonomy page in Confluence and taxonomy module in Archer GRC

steps.title: Group identified risks into L1 categories
sop: Pull the full list of identified enterprise risks from workshops and registers.
Group the risks into L1 categories such as Insurance, Market, Credit, Operational, Strategic, Reputational.
Confirm each risk is assigned to exactly one L1 category.
Done when every identified risk has an assigned L1 category.
verify: Count risks per L1 category and confirm totals sum to the full risk list.
Pass when category totals reconcile to the complete risk count.

steps.title: Break each L1 category into L2 sub-categories
sop: Review the ORSA risk-category naming convention for L2 sub-category structure.
Define L2 sub-categories under each L1 category consistent with the convention.
Assign each risk to its correct L2 sub-category.
Done when every L1 category has defined, populated L2 sub-categories.
verify: Check each L2 sub-category name against the ORSA naming convention list.
Pass when all L2 names conform to the naming convention.

steps.title: Check for duplicate categories against existing nodes
sop: Compare each proposed L1/L2 category name against the existing taxonomy tree.
Flag any proposed category that overlaps an existing node under a different name.
Merge or rename flagged categories to remove duplication.
Done when no proposed category duplicates an existing node.
verify: Re-scan the finalized list for duplicate node names.
Pass when the duplicate scan returns zero matches.

steps.title: Publish the hierarchy diagram to Confluence
sop: Build the L1/L2 hierarchy diagram reflecting the finalized structure.
Publish the diagram to the taxonomy page in Confluence.
Confirm the diagram is dated with the build cycle.
Done when the hierarchy diagram is published and dated in Confluence.
verify: Open the published page and confirm the diagram renders correctly.
Pass when the diagram displays all L1/L2 nodes without errors.

steps.title: Load the finalized hierarchy into Archer GRC
sop: Open the taxonomy module in Archer GRC.
Enter each L1 category and its L2 sub-categories as taxonomy nodes.
Confirm the loaded node count matches the finalized hierarchy count.
Done when the full hierarchy is loaded into the taxonomy module.
verify: Compare the Archer GRC node count to the Confluence diagram node count.
Pass when both counts match exactly.

steps.title: Approve the finalized taxonomy hierarchy
sop: Review the published diagram and loaded taxonomy module together.
Confirm the two-level structure has no duplicate or missing nodes.
Approve the hierarchy as the taxonomy baseline for the cycle.
Done when the Enterprise Risk Manager approves the baseline hierarchy.
verify: Check for the approval note recorded against the taxonomy version.
Pass when the approval note and date are present.

generic.Defined scope/population: The emerging risk register and horizon-scanning findings for the review period
generic.In-scope period: The annual review cycle preceding the Risk Committee meeting
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every active taxonomy node checked against the emerging risk list
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Emerging risk count reviewed matches the register's active count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Annual taxonomy review memo saved with review date and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Emerging risks with no home node logged as candidate taxonomy additions
generic.Test population: All active taxonomy nodes and all active emerging risk entries
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if the review memo is signed off before the Risk Committee cycle
generic.Exception handling path: Coverage gaps routed to the Enterprise Risk Manager for taxonomy change proposal
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review accepted when findings and recommended changes are documented and signed
generic.Evidence location: Annual taxonomy review memo in Confluence

steps.title: Pull the current emerging risk register and scan findings
sop: Export the current emerging risk register from Archer GRC.
Pull the horizon-scanning findings logged for the review period.
Consolidate both sources into a single review working file.
Done when the register and scan findings are consolidated for review.
verify: Check the working file entry count against the live register count.
Pass when the counts match with no entries missing.

steps.title: Walk each taxonomy node against the emerging risk list
sop: Open the active taxonomy tree in Archer GRC alongside the working file.
Check each emerging risk for an existing home node in the taxonomy.
Mark each risk as covered or uncovered by the current structure.
Done when every emerging risk has been checked against the taxonomy.
verify: Sample five marked entries and confirm the coverage call is correct.
Pass when the sample shows accurate coverage determinations.

steps.title: Draft candidate taxonomy additions for uncovered risks
sop: Identify emerging risks flagged as uncovered by the taxonomy.
Draft a candidate new node name, definition, and parent category for each.
Consult the Sustainability Risk Manager on ESG-related candidate nodes.
Done when every uncovered risk has a drafted candidate node.
verify: Review each candidate node draft for a complete definition and parent.
Pass when all candidate drafts are complete.

steps.title: Document review findings in the annual taxonomy review memo
sop: Draft the review memo summarizing coverage results and identified gaps.
List recommended taxonomy changes with supporting rationale.
Attach the candidate node drafts as memo appendices.
Done when the memo documents findings, gaps, and recommended changes.
verify: Read the memo against the working file to confirm nothing is omitted.
Pass when every gap and candidate change appears in the memo.

steps.title: Route the memo for sign-off before Risk Committee
sop: Review the completed annual taxonomy review memo.
Confirm the recommended changes are consistent with the emerging risk register.
Sign off the memo ahead of the Risk Committee cycle.
Done when the memo carries the Enterprise Risk Manager's sign-off.
verify: Check the memo file for the sign-off name and date.
Pass when sign-off is recorded before the Risk Committee meeting date.

steps.title: Close out the task record in Annual taxonomy review memo in Confluence
sop: Review the completed work for "Conduct annual taxonomy review against emerging risks" against its acceptance criteria.
Confirm the finished evidence is stored at Annual taxonomy review memo in Confluence.
Mark the task record as closed for this cycle.
Done when the task record shows closed with evidence stored at Annual taxonomy review memo in Confluence.
verify: Reopen the task record to confirm the closed status and evidence link.
Pass when the record is closed and the evidence is retrievable at Annual taxonomy review memo in Confluence.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full enterprise risk taxonomy document and its Archer GRC configuration
generic.In-scope period: Current effective taxonomy version through its next scheduled review
generic.Required fields populated and valid: L1 category, L2 sub-category, definition, and owner fully populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confluence taxonomy version number matches the Archer GRC loaded version
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confluence document carries a current effective date and version number
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Structural drift between Confluence and Archer GRC logged and reconciled
generic.Test population: Every taxonomy node in the current version
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if the review cadence is on schedule and versions match
generic.Exception handling path: Drift or overdue review routed to the Enterprise Risk Manager for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Taxonomy accepted as current when versions match and review cadence is on track
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise risk taxonomy document in Confluence and taxonomy module in Archer GRC

steps.title: Confirm the taxonomy document exists with a current effective date
sop: Open the enterprise risk taxonomy document in Confluence.
Check the effective date field reflects the current version cycle.
Update the effective date if it has lapsed since the last review.
Done when the document shows a current, accurate effective date.
verify: Compare the effective date to today's date and the review cadence.
Pass when the effective date is within the current review cycle.

steps.title: Confirm the taxonomy structure is fully populated in Archer GRC
sop: Open the taxonomy module in Archer GRC.
Check every node has L1 category, L2 sub-category, definition, and owner populated.
List any node with a missing field for correction.
Done when every taxonomy node has all four fields populated.
verify: Run the field-completeness report in Archer GRC.
Pass when the report shows zero incomplete nodes.

steps.title: Confirm a review cadence is scheduled and tracked
sop: Check the taxonomy record for the scheduled annual review date.
Confirm the last review date is within the required cadence window.
Update the next scheduled review date if it is missing or overdue.
Done when a valid next review date is recorded and tracked.
verify: Check the review tracker for the recorded next review date.
Pass when the next review date falls within the required cadence.

steps.title: Confirm the Confluence and Archer GRC version numbers match
sop: Read the version number on the Confluence taxonomy document.
Read the version number loaded in the Archer GRC taxonomy module.
Compare the two version numbers for an exact match.
Done when both systems show the same taxonomy version number.
verify: Re-check both version fields side by side after any update.
Pass when the version numbers are identical.

steps.title: Reconcile any structural drift between the two systems
sop: Identify any node or field differing between Confluence and Archer GRC.
Determine the correct current value using the last approved change log entry.
Update whichever system is out of date to match the approved version.
Done when both systems reflect the same, approved taxonomy structure.
verify: Re-run the version and field comparison after reconciliation.
Pass when no drift remains between Confluence and Archer GRC.

steps.title: Close out the task record in Enterprise risk taxonomy document in Confluence and taxonomy module in Archer GRC
sop: Review the completed work for "Define and maintain enterprise risk taxonomy" against its acceptance criteria.
Confirm the finished evidence is stored at Enterprise risk taxonomy document in Confluence and taxonomy module in Archer GRC.
Mark the task record as closed for this cycle.
Done when the task record shows closed with evidence stored in the taxonomy library.
verify: Reopen the task record to confirm the closed status and evidence link.
Pass when the record is closed with evidence retrievable in the taxonomy library.

generic.Defined scope/population: New risk categories triggered by business strategy or regulatory change
generic.In-scope period: The current taxonomy change intake cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Category name, definition, trigger, and proposed parent node all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pending entry count matches the taxonomy change log's pending count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change request form saved with submission date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overlapping category candidates logged and resolved before submission

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if the proposed category does not overlap an existing node
generic.Exception handling path: Overlapping proposals routed back to the requester for revision
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entry accepted as pending when trigger, definition, and parent node are recorded
generic.Evidence location: Taxonomy change log and taxonomy change request form in Archer GRC

steps.title: Capture the trigger for the new risk category
sop: Open the taxonomy change request form in Archer GRC.
Record the trigger for the new category: strategy change, new product, or new regulation.
Attach the source document supporting the trigger.
Done when the trigger field and supporting document are recorded.
verify: Reopen the form to confirm the trigger field and attachment are saved.
Pass when both the trigger and its supporting document are present.

steps.title: Draft the category name, definition, and proposed parent node
sop: Draft a clear category name and working definition.
Identify the proposed parent L1/L2 node for the new category.
Enter the name, definition, and parent node into the change request form.
Done when the form carries a complete name, definition, and parent node.
verify: Read the drafted definition for clarity and completeness.
Pass when the definition clearly distinguishes the category from existing nodes.

steps.title: Check the proposed category does not overlap an existing node
sop: Compare the proposed category against the current taxonomy tree in Archer GRC.
Flag any overlap with an existing L1/L2 node.
Revise the proposal to remove overlap where found.
Done when the proposal is confirmed distinct from existing nodes.
verify: Re-run the comparison against the taxonomy tree after any revision.
Pass when no overlap remains with an existing node.

steps.title: Record the new category as a pending entry
sop: Open the taxonomy change log in Archer GRC.
Add the new category as a pending entry awaiting validation.
Link the change request form to the pending log entry.
Done when the pending entry is logged and linked to its change request.
verify: Open the change log to confirm the pending entry and link are present.
Pass when the entry status reads pending with a linked request.

steps.title: Notify the Enterprise Risk Manager of the queued category
sop: Review the pending entry and its supporting change request.
Confirm the trigger, definition, and parent node are complete.
Notify the Enterprise Risk Manager that the category is queued for validation.
Done when the notification is sent with the pending entry referenced.
verify: Check the change log for the notification timestamp and recipient.
Pass when the notification is logged against the pending entry.

steps.title: Close out the task record in Taxonomy change log and taxonomy change request form in Archer GRC
sop: Review the completed work for "Document new risk categories" against its acceptance criteria.
Confirm the finished evidence is stored at Taxonomy change log and taxonomy change request form in Archer GRC.
Mark the task record as closed for this cycle.
Done when the task record shows closed with evidence stored at Taxonomy change log and taxonomy change request form in Archer GRC.
verify: Reopen the task record to confirm the closed status and evidence link.
Pass when the record is closed with evidence retrievable in the change log.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every taxonomy modification made during the current change cycle
generic.In-scope period: The current taxonomy change cycle before publication
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rationale field completed for every add, merge, split, or retire action
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Change log entry count matches the taxonomy version diff count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Supporting driver document attached to each change log entry
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entries missing rationale flagged and returned before approval

generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete entries routed back to the change requester for completion
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rationale accepted when driver and supporting document are attached and approved

steps.title: Open the taxonomy change log entry for each modification
sop: Open the taxonomy change log in Archer GRC for the current cycle.
List every add, merge, split, or retire action recorded this cycle.
Confirm each action has a corresponding change log entry.
Done when every modification this cycle has an open change log entry.
verify: Count the listed actions against the change log entry count.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Record the driver behind each change action
sop: Identify the business or regulatory driver behind each change.
Enter the driver description into the change log entry's rationale field.
Confirm the driver is specific, not a generic placeholder.
Done when every change entry has a specific, documented driver.
verify: Read each rationale field for specificity and clarity.
Pass when no rationale field reads as generic or blank.

steps.title: Attach the supporting document for each change
sop: Locate the supporting document such as a regulatory bulletin, strategy memo, or RCSA finding.
Attach the document to the corresponding change log entry.
Confirm the attachment link opens correctly.
Done when every change entry has a working supporting-document attachment.
verify: Open a sample of attachments to confirm they load and match the entry.
Pass when the sampled attachments open and are relevant to the change.

steps.title: Confirm the rationale field is complete before approval
sop: Review every change entry for a completed rationale and attachment.
Flag any entry missing rationale or attachment as not ready for approval.
Route flagged entries back for completion before marking approved.
Done when every entry has rationale and attachment complete.
verify: Run the change log completeness check for missing fields.
Pass when the completeness check shows zero missing rationale fields.

steps.title: Cross-check the entry count against the taxonomy version diff
sop: Pull the taxonomy version diff report comparing this cycle's changes.
Compare the diff report's change count to the change log entry count.
Investigate any discrepancy between the two counts.
Done when the change log count matches the version diff count.
verify: Reconcile any remaining discrepancy before approving the cycle.
Pass when the counts match with zero unexplained differences.

steps.title: Close out the task record in Taxonomy change log in Archer GRC and Confluence
sop: Review the completed work for "Document rationale for taxonomy changes" against its acceptance criteria.
Confirm the finished evidence is stored at Taxonomy change log in Archer GRC and Confluence.
Mark the task record as closed for this cycle.
Done when the task record shows closed with evidence stored at Taxonomy change log in Archer GRC and Confluence.
verify: Reopen the task record to confirm the closed status and evidence link.
Pass when the record is closed and the evidence is retrievable at Taxonomy change log in Archer GRC and Confluence.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full operating-model process and legal entity inventory

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Mapped process count matches the process catalog inventory count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed crosswalk published to the risk data mart with a publish date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmapped processes flagged and routed to the process owner
generic.Test population: Every business process and legal entity in the operating-model catalog
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only if no in-scope process or entity is left unmapped
generic.Exception handling path: Multi-category mappings without justification routed for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mapping accepted when every process links to exactly one justified taxonomy node
generic.Evidence location: Process-to-taxonomy crosswalk in the risk data mart

steps.title: Pull the current process and entity inventory
sop: Query the operating-model process catalog in the enterprise data warehouse.
Export the current process and legal entity inventory.
Confirm the export reflects the current published process catalog version.
Done when the current process and entity inventory export is ready.
verify: Check the export row count against the process catalog's live count.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Map each process to its primary taxonomy node
sop: Open the mapping module in Archer GRC.
Assign each business process or legal entity to its primary risk taxonomy node.
Confirm the assignment reflects the process's dominant risk exposure.
Done when every process or entity has an assigned primary taxonomy node.
verify: Sample ten mapped processes and confirm the taxonomy node fits the process.
Pass when the sample shows correctly fitted taxonomy nodes.

steps.title: Flag processes with no taxonomy linkage
sop: Run the mapping completeness check in Archer GRC.
List every process or entity with no taxonomy node assigned.
Send the unmapped list to the relevant process owner for follow-up.
Done when every unmapped process is flagged and routed to its owner.
verify: Re-run the completeness check after follow-up responses are received.
Pass when the unmapped count decreases with owner responses logged.

steps.title: Check multi-category mappings carry justification
sop: Identify any process or entity mapped to more than one L1 category.
Confirm a documented justification exists for the multi-category mapping.
Remove or correct mappings lacking justification.
Done when every multi-category mapping carries documented justification.
verify: Review the justification text for each multi-category mapping.
Pass when every multi-category mapping has a valid justification on file.

steps.title: Publish the completed crosswalk to the risk data mart
sop: Finalize the process-to-taxonomy crosswalk table.
Publish the crosswalk to the risk data mart in the enterprise data warehouse.
Confirm downstream consumers can query the published crosswalk.
Done when the crosswalk is published and queryable in the risk data mart.
verify: Run a test query against the published crosswalk table.
Pass when the query returns the expected mapped process count.
